Structures and EngineeringPublic and Infrastructure

Experience of the BOW Structures and BOW Projects team prior to BOW. These projects are not BOW contracts.

The BOW Structures profile highlights Melbourne Airport as team experience in masonry wall removal and structural temporary works.

The scope includes inspections, demolition and construction methodology reviews, hardstand platforms, precast propping, temporary support for non-loadbearing façade precast walls and related design consulting.
